original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚索科托州警方突袭匪徒藏身处 解救两名被绑人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚索科托州警方在亚博地方政府区对疑似匪徒藏身处展开清剿行动，与匪徒发生激烈枪战，随后解救出两名被绑架人员。行动于周日凌晨展开，由多支警力联合实施，依据情报锁定丹塔夫基村及周边山丘。警方称突入时遭猛烈射击，枪战持续数小时。目前信息仅来自单一来源。

location.site: 亚博地方政府区丹塔夫基村及周边山丘
location.raw_text: Dan Tafki village and surrounding hills opposite Binji Musa in Yabo Local Government Area, Sokoto State

key_facts.fact: 索科托州警方在亚博地方政府区突袭匪徒藏身处并解救两名被绑人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Sokoto State Police Command has rescued two kidnapped victims after a fierce gun battle with suspected bandits during a clearance operation in Yabo Local Government Area

key_facts.fact: 行动于周日凌晨展开，由多支警力联合实施
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The operation, conducted in the early hours of Sunday, November 8, involved a joint team of operatives from the 7 Police Mobile Force, Violent Crime Response Unit, Anti-Kidnapping Unit and Yabo Police Division

key_facts.fact: 行动依据情报锁定丹塔夫基村及周边山丘
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: launched following credible intelligence about the presence of armed bandits and their captives at Dan Tafki village and surrounding hills opposite Binji Musa in Yabo LGA

key_facts.fact: 警方突入时遭猛烈射击，枪战持续数小时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the security operatives came under heavy gunfire upon storming the suspected hideout, triggering a fierce gun duel that lasted several hours

uncertainties: 匪徒身份仅为疑似，尚未确认
事件仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
伤亡及被捕情况未在现有正文中说明
